findings.status: confirmed source growth risk, causal impact unverified
findings.detail: Every added world/actor descendant defers install_item; its _seen dictionary stores instance IDs at51–52 and never erases them. Repeated projectile/transient-node creation can grow historical keys until this presentation owner is freed. These are integer→bool entries, not strong Node/RID references. _seen is not traversed in the per-frame refresh loop, so static growth alone cannot explain steadily rising per-frame time or establish an audio cause. Stationary Home without new nodes does not intrinsically grow it.
findings.limited_followup_metric: Only if later profiling remains needed: compare _seen.size with currently live descendants and object/memory count; do not call it an RID leak.

findings.status: conditional retention/task risk, not demonstrated leak
findings.detail: _terrain_materials retains strong ShaderMaterial references, _latches retains weak references, and neither array prunes removed members. If terrain/latches are rebuilt within a surviving presentation, resources/iteration can retain historical entries. Formal terrain/lights are assembled initially, so no unconditional time-based growth is established. _node_added schedules one deferred install per eligible node without coalescing; subtree construction may create bursty redundant recursive visits, not necessarily a perpetual queue.
findings.limited_followup_metric: If needed later: terrain material count/live-owner count, valid/invalid latch count, install_item calls and deferred completion backlog during actual construction versus idle.

findings.detail: Foreground residents are capped64, retirement history capped64; retirees queue_free their Sprite2D/material owners. _tracked and _trail_fields erase node IDs on node_removed at122–124. Protection arrays clear each refresh, and spec cache replaces only the last cell key/result. Normal HUD ammo cells rebuild only when capacity changes and old cells are removed/freed; fixed region UI position keys replace values. No obvious unconditional frame-by-frame Node/RID accumulation is present in these paths. No direct unmanaged RenderingServer RID allocation was found in reviewed foreground/light/HUD sources.

There is NO full-screen-rectangle fragment early return/discard. Derivatives, inverse matrix and texture sampling run before the protection loop; its only break is i>=protection_count at45, and it does not break when protection reaches0. A full-screen backdrop can merge _protect to one rectangle, reducing loop count, but does not prove all fragment work disappears. _exposed_regions atforeground396–426 does break its CPU subtraction loop when regions become empty; branch distance uses merged _protect, and per-resident uploaded masks shrink accordingly. _static_protect/_dynamic_protect append before union merging at173–175 and are not capped by MAX_PROTECTION; MAX64 is an overflow/hide policy on merged masks, not a cap on source collection work.

findings.status: confirmed active/pause work difference, magnitude unmeasured
findings.detail: Foreground is PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS and still performs protection/sync/material uploads while tree-paused, passing delta0; fade/clock advance stops, not the whole CPU refresh. Existing admitted nonzero-alpha sprites can remain submitted even though the full-screen protection makes their shader alpha0. Presentation and parallax inherit pausable world modes; pause stops their _process-driven light sorting/wind updates, actor physics and enemy/projectile activity, while retained lights/occluders are not explicitly hidden by pausing. Visible lights are capped8, but total emitter/occluder creation is upfront level-dependent; no automatic time-based light creation is seen. Static code cannot determine actual shadow redraw/cache/GPU cost.

App is PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS and continues region HUD updates and _layout_region_hud during pause while IN_STAGE. Layout creates temporary blocker/candidate arrays and scores current enemies/projectiles/modules; cost varies with live contents, not a retained per-frame history. DemoGameHud refreshes values and redraws ammo cells while visible; normal context presentation plus _process can refresh more than once/frame. This is repeated CPU/layout work, not demonstrated progressive growth.

findings.status: confirmed visibility behavior; phone explanation remains inference
findings.detail: Focus out/in clears input and epochs; App focus-out closes Home codex, not a general audio or renderer shutdown. Ordinary loader visibilitychange only checks updates and returns while hidden; it does not implement a special audio fix. Official single-thread no-thread read handler receives Worklet read on main, calls synchronous out_callback and posts chunk. Browser background RAF throttling can reduce main/render contention while audible audio messaging continues, which is compatible with smoother background audio. Browser policy and actual device timing were not measured here; focus and document visibility are not interchangeable.

Actual in-run pause freezes pausable world state and cancels input; Home navigation merely blocks Home input and does not tree-pause. Full-screen menu backdrop atdemo_menu1097 participates in foreground protection. Pause also pauses ambience beds/details and prevents new details, while GameMusic remains ALWAYS and ducks toward PAUSE_GAIN rather than stopping music. Therefore improved paused audio cannot statically be attributed only to shader/rendering or only to decoding.
